stories.title: First Tracks ANB033 protects celiac intestinal villi in Phase 1b
stories.takeaway: October 12: CD122 blockade reduced gluten-induced villus injury and symptoms in a 32-person cohort, distinct from the recent FB102 celiac report.
stories.what_happened: ANB033 improved the placebo-adjusted villus-height/crypt-depth change by +0.49 (p=0.009) and reduced intraepithelial lymphocyte density (p<0.001) after gluten challenge.
stories.why_it_matters: Supports immune–epithelial endpoints alongside TEER and ROS for gut-chip experiments.
stories.caveat: Company topline, small Phase 1b cohort; long-term mucosal healing unproven.

stories.title: Mirum Phase 3 EXPAND positive for gut-targeted bile-acid drug
stories.takeaway: October 12: maralixibat met its itching endpoint and reduced serum bile acids; FDA supplemental filing planned in 2027.
stories.what_happened: In 52 patients, itch improved 0.98 points versus placebo (p=0.0004); serum bile acids showed a 69% treatment effect (p<0.0001).
stories.why_it_matters: Shows ileal transport can be manipulated therapeutically; bile-acid flux could enrich gut-chip functional readouts.
stories.caveat: Small trial; diarrhea in 64% on drug versus 11% on placebo; not yet approved for this use.

stories.title: Merck $1.3B-acquired eye drug faces safety and differentiation concerns
stories.takeaway: New full Brunello data weaken the case for remigromig despite meeting noninferiority.
stories.what_happened: Proliferative diabetic retinopathy was 6.7%/6.1% versus 0.9% with ranibizumab; vision gains were 9.1/8.7 versus 11.8 letters.
stories.why_it_matters: Industry lesson for NAM validation: positive primary endpoints need comparator performance and safety context.
stories.caveat: Additional trial and long-term data are pending; adverse-event mechanisms remain uncertain.

stories.title: Perfused organ-chip chamber geometry changes spheroid growth and toxicity
stories.takeaway: October 7 ACS paper: round chambers outperformed rhombus and rectangle under standardized perfusion.
stories.what_happened: Flow simulations and HepG2 experiments linked geometry to intragel flow, viability and spheroid morphology; ECM altered function and chip versus plate toxicity responses differed.
stories.why_it_matters: Directly relevant to multiplex chip engineering: matching inlet flow does not ensure matched local shear or tissue exposure.
stories.caveat: HepG2 and 2D flow simulation limit generalizability to primary human intestinal tissue.

stories.title: Dynamic fed-state gastric pH improves oral-drug PBPK predictions
stories.takeaway: October 9 paper: dynamic stomach-pH models predicted food effects better than static pH 5.
stories.what_happened: Dynamic multi-compartment and one-compartment models predicted effects for ibuprofen sodium, itraconazole and posaconazole; static pH misclassified itraconazole.
stories.why_it_matters: Highlights why realistic dynamic exposure conditions matter for translating intestinal chips into drug-testing tools.
stories.caveat: Only three compounds; computational prediction does not demonstrate chip-based human absorption prediction.
